@multiRename.mediaField.exifIso.sameAsSourceJustification: “ISO” is the international name of the light-sensitivity standard; Taiwanese camera UIs and the catalog itself (settings.appearance.dateTimeFormat.opt.iso “ISO 8601”) keep it Latin, and the @key description asks to keep it.
